title: 第 2 讲：定语从句 I —关系代词 who / which / that

reading.title: The Team and the Tools

sentences.en: People and tools build every good service.
sentences.zh: 人和工具共同打造好的服务。

sentences.en: Anna is the colleague who manages our release pipeline.
sentences.zh: 安娜是管理我们发布流水线的那位同事。

sentences.en: She is the expert that everyone trusts.
sentences.zh: 她是大家都信任的专家。

sentences.en: Last quarter we hired an intern whose tests caught a real bug.
sentences.zh: 上个季度我们招了一名实习生，其编写的测试抓到了一个真实的 bug。

sentences.en: The lead assigns each ticket to a developer, and a checklist guides every new teammate.
sentences.zh: 组长把每个工单分配给一名开发者，还有一份清单指导每位新成员。

sentences.en: The tool which checks our logs is reliable; it saves hours each week and reports everything that breaks before users notice.
sentences.zh: 那个检查日志的工具很可靠：它每周节省数小时，还能在用户察觉之前报告一切问题。

sentences.en: The ticket we shipped came from a customer whom nobody had contacted.
sentences.zh: 我们交付的那个工单来自一位此前没人联系过的客户。

sentences.en: This is the best team that I have ever joined.
sentences.zh: 这是我加入过的最好的团队。

sentences.en: I recommend the rules we apply here: trust people, and hire carefully.
sentences.zh: 我推荐我们在这里践行的规则：信任他人，谨慎招人。

reading.translation: 人和工具共同打造好的服务。安娜是管理我们发布流水线的那位同事。她是大家都信任的专家。上个季度我们招了一名实习生，其编写的测试抓到了一个真实的 bug。组长把每个工单分配给一名开发者，还有一份清单指导每位新成员。那个检查日志的工具很可靠：它每周节省数小时，还能在用户察觉之前报告一切问题。我们交付的那个工单来自一位此前没人联系过的客户。这是我加入过的最好的团队。我推荐我们在这里践行的规则：信任他人，谨慎招人。

keyPoints.sentence: Anna is the colleague who manages our release pipeline.
keyPoints.analysis: 先行词 the colleague（指人）；从句 who manages our release pipeline 缺主语 → who。还原验证：She manages our release pipeline 成立；who 作主语不可省略

keyPoints.sentence: She is the expert (that) everyone trusts.
keyPoints.analysis: 先行词 the expert（指人）；从句缺宾语（trusts 后面悬空）→ that / whom，可省略。还原验证：everyone trusts her 成立

keyPoints.sentence: ...an intern whose tests caught a real bug.
keyPoints.analysis: 从句 whose tests caught a real bug 主谓齐全，缺的是 tests 的定语 → whose（= the intern's），「……的」

keyPoints.sentence: The ticket (that) we shipped came from a customer whom nobody had contacted.
keyPoints.analysis: 一省一留：the ticket 作 shipped 的宾语，可省略；a customer 作 contacted 的宾语，正式写作用 whom。还原验证：we shipped it；nobody had contacted him

keyPoints.sentence: This is the best team that I have ever joined.
keyPoints.analysis: 先行词被最高级 the best 修饰 → 关系词优先 that（作 joined 的宾语）。还原验证：I have ever joined it 成立

notes.heading: 先定义：定语从句 / 先行词 / 关系代词

blocks.text: 先给术语定性，再谈规则 — 否则公式没有意义。

rows: 跟在名词后面修饰它的从句，作用相当于一个长形容词
Anna is the colleague **who manages our release pipeline**.
被定语从句修饰的那个名词，也是关系词指代的对象
Anna is the **colleague** who manages our release pipeline.（colleague 是先行词）
引导定语从句的词：既把从句挂在先行词上，又在从句里充当一个成分
**who** manages our release pipeline（who 既连接，又当从句的主语）

blocks.text: 关系代词「一肩两挑」：从句里总有一个位置是留给它的。所以选关系词，本质就是看从句缺什么成分。

items: **找先行词**：看关系词前面紧挨着的名词 / 代词，确认它指人还是指物
**看从句缺什么**：把先行词代回从句，还原成独立句 — 缺主语、缺宾语，还是缺定语
**按缺口选词**：缺主语 → who / which / that；缺宾语 → whom / which / that（可省略）；缺定语 → whose

rows: Anna is the colleague **who manages** our release pipeline.
She is the expert **(that) everyone trusts**.
...an intern **whose tests caught** a real bug

blocks.text: **还原验证法**：把从句单独拎出来，用先行词补位。everyone trusts **her** 成立 → 缺宾语；**She manages** our release pipeline 成立 → 缺主语；**the intern's** tests caught a bug 成立 → 缺定语（whose）。
who 指人、which 指物、that 人或物都能指。限制性定语从句（对先行词起限定作用，去掉后句意就变 — 与 L04 的非限制性从句相对）里，日常写作中 that 最常用。

rows: 先行词指人、从句缺主语
Anna is the colleague **who manages** our release pipeline.
先行词指物、从句缺主语
The tool **which checks** our logs is reliable.
先行词被最高级 / 序数词 / 不定代词修饰
the **best** team **that** I have ever joined / the **first** ticket that she closed / **everything that** breaks
the developer and the tool **that** saved the release（非课文例句）

blocks.text: **记忆口诀「最、第、不定、混合」**：最高级、序数词、不定代词、人+物混合 — 四类先行词，关系词优先 that。另：关系词在从句中作主语时永远不能省略。

notes.heading: 关系词作宾语时可以省略

blocks.text: 关系代词在从句中作宾语时可以直接省掉：The ticket **(that) we shipped** came from a customer. / I recommend the rules **(that) we apply** here. whom 较正式，日常写作里多数人直接省略或用 that。
**快速判断**：关系词后面紧跟动词 → 它是主语，不能省（who manages...）；关系词后面紧跟「主语 + 动词」 → 它是宾语，可省（(that) everyone trusts）。

本讲课文英文共 105 词、词形 type 80 个，自然复现已入账旧词 17 个词条：build、release、pipeline、last、quarter、intern、test、bug、lead、ticket、developer、check、log、save、break、notice、ship。原始分数 17/80 ≈ 21%（旧词词条 / 课文词形 type）；若按课文英文总词数计为 17/105 ≈ 16%。两种口径均 ≥ 10%（一册常规讲阶段目标），达标。

output.prompt: 用 2~3 句英文概括课文大意。
output.sample:
People and tools build every good service. Anna is the colleague who manages our pipeline, and the tool which checks our logs is reliable. I recommend the rules we apply here.
（范文仅供参考：覆盖「人 → 工具 → 规则」三线索、含定语从句、主干无错即可，不要求逐词一致。）

output.prompt: 以你的团队和工具为主题写 3~4 句，至少含 2 个定语从句（其中 1 个用 whose、1 个关系词作宾语且省略）。
output.reference:
参考起点：
The developer who owns this service is very careful.
A tool that checks our tests saves us hours every week.
The intern whose idea we shipped won the team award.
The bug (that) we fixed yesterday taught me a lot.
output.sample:
Our team has a developer who owns the payment service. The intern whose tests caught a real bug is now a full member. We use a tool that checks every deploy before it goes live. The bug (that) we fixed last week taught me a lot.
（范文仅供参考：3~4 句、2 个以上定语从句、whose 与宾格省略各出现一次即可。）

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 3~4 句、主题为团队与工具、至少 2 个定语从句（含 1 个 whose、1 处关系词作宾语且省略）

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 逐句用「缺成分判定法」核对 — 先行词指人 / 指物、从句缺口（主语 / 宾语 / 定语）、关系词与缺口匹配；作主语的关系词没有被省略

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 每个从句关系词正确，whose 与宾格省略各出现一次，即通过

output.prompt: 用「缺成分判定法」逐句检查你仿写的定语从句：找先行词 → 看从句缺什么成分 → 核对关系词。
output.reference: 检查顺序：① 找先行词（指人 / 指物）→ ② 把先行词代回从句看缺什么 → ③ 核对关系词与缺口是否匹配
output.sample:
例：The intern whose tests caught a bug is reliable.
① 先行词 the intern（指人）；② 从句 whose tests caught a bug 中 tests 缺定语（= the intern's tests）；③ 缺定语 → whose ✅
例：The bug (that) we fixed taught me a lot.
① 先行词 the bug（指物）；② 从句 (that) we fixed 缺宾语（we fixed it）；③ 缺宾语 → that / which 或省略 ✅

practice.title: 缺成分判定 — 判断定语从句缺少什么成分（① 缺主语 / ② 缺宾语 / ③ 缺定语）

questions.stem: The engineer who wrote this module left yesterday.（从句：who wrote this module）
questions.explanation: ① 缺主语。依据一（语法规则）：关系词后紧跟动词 wrote，who 在从句中作主语。依据二（还原法）：He wrote this module 成立 → 缺动作发出者（主语）。

questions.stem: We use a dashboard that shows the real-time metrics.（从句：that shows the real-time metrics）
questions.explanation: ① 缺主语。依据一（语法规则）：that 后紧跟动词 shows，that 作主语、不能省略。依据二（还原法）：It shows the real-time metrics 成立 → 缺主语。

questions.stem: This is the PR which I reviewed this morning.（从句：which I reviewed this morning）
questions.explanation: ② 缺宾语。依据一（语法规则）：which 后紧跟「主语 I + 动词 reviewed」，reviewed 是及物动词且后面悬空。依据二（还原法）：I reviewed it 成立 → 缺宾语，which 也可省略。

questions.stem: The developer whose laptop crashed called support at noon.（从句：whose laptop crashed）
questions.explanation: ③ 缺定语。依据一（语法规则）：whose 后是名词 laptop，从句主谓齐全（laptop crashed），缺的是「……的」。依据二（还原法）：the developer's laptop crashed 成立 → 缺定语。

practice.title: 选关系代词 — 用 who / which / that / whom / whose 填空

questions.stem: Kelly is the colleague ___ leads the migration.
questions.explanation: 缺主语、先行词 colleague 指人 → who / that。依据一（语法规则）：从句缺主语只能用 who / which / that，指人排除 which。依据二（还原法）：She leads the migration 成立 → 缺主语，who 不可省略。

questions.stem: We built a tool ___ checks every deploy.
questions.explanation: 缺主语、先行词 tool 指物 → which / that。依据一（语法规则）：指物的主语位置用 which 或 that，不能用 who / whom。依据二（还原法）：It checks every deploy 成立 → 缺主语。

questions.stem: Ben is the expert ___ the whole team trusts.
questions.explanation: 缺宾语、先行词 Ben 指人 → whom / that（口语中也可 who），或省略。依据一（语法规则）：缺宾语指人用 whom / that。依据二（还原法）：the whole team trusts him 成立 → 缺宾语，作宾语时可省略。

questions.stem: Everything ___ runs in production is tested twice.
questions.explanation: 先行词 Everything 是不定代词 → 用 that。依据一（语法规则）：先行词被不定代词修饰时关系词优先 that。依据二（排除法）：先行词不是人，who / whom 不行；此处缺主语不能省略 → 只能填 that。

practice.title: 改错 — 改正关系代词的误用

questions.stem: The developer which manages the service is on leave this week.
questions.reference: The developer who manages the service is on leave this week.（或 The developer that manages the service is on leave this week.）
questions.explanation: 指人不用 which。依据一（语法规则）：which 只指物，先行词 developer 是人，缺主语用 who / that。依据二（还原法）：He manages the service 成立 → 缺主语、指人 → who。

questions.stem: The colleague whom leads the migration is Kelly.
questions.reference: The colleague who leads the migration is Kelly.（或 The colleague that leads the migration is Kelly.）
questions.explanation: whom 只能作宾语，不能作主语。依据一（语法规则）：从句缺主语用 who / that，whom 是宾格。依据二（还原法）：She leads the migration 成立 → 缺主语；whom 站在主语位不成立。

questions.stem: The tool checks every deploy is free.
questions.reference: The tool which checks every deploy is free.（或 The tool that checks every deploy is free.）
questions.explanation: 关系词作主语时不能省略。依据一（语法规则）：从句缺主语必须补 which / that。依据二（还原法）：还原后是 It checks every deploy，主语空缺，省掉关系词就成了双谓语错句。

questions.stem: This is the best dashboard which I have ever built.
questions.reference: This is the best dashboard that I have ever built.
questions.explanation: 最高级修饰先行词时关系词优先 that。依据一（语法规则）：先行词被最高级 the best 修饰，规范用法是 that。依据二（排除法）：此处缺宾语（I have ever built it），把 which 换成 that 后从句完整，且符合「最、第、不定、混合」用 that 的规则。

practice.title: 翻译 — 用定语从句翻译

questions.stem: 管理这个服务的同事下周休假。
answers: The colleague who manages this service is on leave next week.
The colleague that manages this service is on leave next week.
questions.explanation: 缺主语、指人 → who / that：The colleague who manages this service is on leave next week. 依据一（语法规则）：从句缺主语指人用 who / that，不能省略。依据二（还原法）：He manages this service 成立 → 缺主语。

questions.stem: 这就是我昨天修的那个 bug。
answers: This is the bug that I fixed yesterday.
This is the bug which I fixed yesterday.
This is the bug I fixed yesterday.
questions.explanation: 缺宾语 → that / which / 省略：This is the bug (that) I fixed yesterday. 依据一（语法规则）：关系词作宾语时可省略。依据二（还原法）：I fixed it 成立 → 缺宾语。

questions.stem: 我们上个季度招了一位测试抓到 bug 的实习生。
answers: Last quarter we hired an intern whose tests caught a bug.
We hired an intern whose tests caught a bug last quarter.
questions.explanation: 「……的」缺定语 → whose：...an intern whose tests caught a bug. 依据一（语法规则）：从句主谓齐全（tests caught）却带「的」的意思 → 用 whose。依据二（还原法）：the intern's tests caught a bug 成立 → whose = the intern's。

practice.title: 判断下列 5 处正误 — 正确打 ✓，错误的改正

questions.stem: This is the best ticket that I have ever taken.
questions.explanation: ✅ 正确。依据一（语法规则）：最高级 the best 修饰先行词，用 that。依据二（还原法）：I have ever taken it 成立 → 缺宾语，that 保留或省略均可。

questions.stem: The manager which hired me left last month.
questions.correction: The manager who hired me left last month.（或 The manager that hired me left last month.）
questions.explanation: ❌ which 只指物，先行词 manager 是人。依据一（语法规则）：指人、缺主语用 who / that。依据二（还原法）：He hired me 成立 → 缺主语、指人 → who。

questions.stem: The tool that checks our logs saves us hours every week.
questions.explanation: ✅ 正确。依据一（语法规则）：先行词 tool 指物，that 在从句中作主语。依据二（还原法）：It checks our logs 成立 → 缺主语，关系词不能省略。

questions.stem: The expert whom designed the schema is on leave.
questions.correction: The expert who designed the schema is on leave.（或 The expert that designed the schema is on leave.）
questions.explanation: ❌ whom 只能作宾语。依据一（语法规则）：缺主语用 who / that，whom 是宾格。依据二（还原法）：He designed the schema 成立 → 缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The ticket which I took yesterday is still open.
questions.explanation: ✅ 正确。依据一（语法规则）：关系词在从句中作 took 的宾语，指物用 which（that 亦可、或省略）。依据二（改写还原）：I took the ticket yesterday 成立 → which 顶宾语位正确。

practice.title: 造句 — 用定语从句介绍你的团队和工具

questions.stem: 以你的团队和工具为主题写 3~4 句，至少含 2 个定语从句（其中 1 个用 whose、1 个关系词作宾语且省略），写完用「缺成分判定法」逐句自检。

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 3~4 句、主题为团队与工具、至少 2 个定语从句（含 1 个 whose、1 处关系词作宾语且省略）

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 逐句用「缺成分判定法」核对 — 先行词指人 / 指物、从句缺口（主语 / 宾语 / 定语）、关系词与缺口匹配；作主语的关系词没有被省略

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 每个从句关系词正确，whose 与宾格省略各出现一次，即通过
